verdict.rationale: Error tracking is a fair axis for an observability platform like Datadog, but the evidence pack has nothing on it. The APM, Watchdog and Dynamic Instrumentation items are bare titles and say nothing about grouping errors into issues, stack traces, release tracking or regression detection. The integrations blurb about tracking deployments is an adjacent feature and does not show the error-tracking capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, and regression detection
